title: Set up the shared AtlasNG tooling
description: Adds the shared config packages, writes thin ESLint, Prettier, commitlint and TypeScript configs, and registers the plugin in nx.json.

prefix.description: Angular selector prefix written to the ESLint selector rules. Defaults to the prefix in the nx.json generator defaults, or app.

skipPackageJson.description: Do not add the config packages to package.json.

skipFormat.description: Do not format the changed files.
